summary: Tested staff approval (super admin only), project gallery, light/dark theme toggle, plus regression on login, booking and membership. Backend: 33/33 pytest pass (8 new in test_staff_gallery.py plus 25 regression). One old assertion was updated: a verified staff account now gets 403 at login until approved. Frontend: the Staff nav link shows only for the super admin. The /admin/staff table shows the right statuses, approve is disabled for unverified accounts, and approve/revoke/delete work with toasts. Pending staff see the 'in attesa di approvazione' message at login; approved staff get /admin without the Staff link. Gallery upload, remove, save, public gallery and lightbox prev/next/close/backdrop all work. The theme toggle sets html data-theme='light', saves to localStorage and survives reload and navigation, on desktop and mobile. Booking and become-member flows still work. MAIN ISSUE: in light mode, text over photos is dark-on-dark and unreadable (home hero, hero next-event card, page headers on eventi/progetti/chi-siamo/5x1000, the 'Scopri il Mali' tiles, the login side panel brand and quote).

minor.issue: If RESEND_API_KEY is set but EMAIL_FROM is missing, formataddr((name, None)) raises AttributeError (verified). try_send_email only catches HTTPException/ValueError, so bookings, registrations and approvals would return 500 in production. Fix: check EMAIL_FROM at startup or fall back, and catch generic Exception in try_send_email.

seed looks up the admin with settings.ADMIN_EMAIL without lowercasing, while is_super_admin and staff queries lowercase it. If ADMIN_EMAIL on Render has uppercase letters, seed can create a duplicate admin that is never super admin. Lowercase it everywhere.

ui_bugs.component: Light theme, all photo zones (_tokens.scss photo-zone rule)
ui_bugs.issue: RCA: body sets color: var(--text), which resolves to dark #1c1915 in light mode. The rule '.hero, .ph.has-bg, .hero-ev, .auth-shell .side, .tile, .event-card .media { @include dark-text }' only redefines the --text variable and never sets 'color'. So h1/h3/p elements without an explicit colour inherit the dark colour already computed on body. Measured: --text on .hero is #f4f4f6, but the h1 computed colour is rgb(28,25,21). Unreadable: home hero 'Radici maliane,', the next-event card title (dark on dark glass), page-header titles ('Eventi e', 'Il tuo 5x1000 a', etc.), Mali tile titles and descriptions, the login side brand 'Giguiya' and quote, and likely event-card date badges. Fix: add 'color: var(--text);' to that rule (and check .event-card .media badges).

integration_issues.issue: There is no frontend guard. The API returns 403 correctly and a toast shows 'Riservato all'amministratore principale', but the page keeps its loading skeleton forever. Add a superAdmin guard or redirect, or show the error state.

issues: The hamburger (navbar-mobile-toggle) ends at x=392 and is clipped and flush with the viewport edge since the theme toggle was added. Reduce gaps or hide the 'Diventa socio' pill text on narrow screens.
No Escape or arrow-key support (Escape tested, does nothing) and no body scroll lock. Nice-to-have for accessibility.

action_items: HIGH: add 'color: var(--text);' to the photo-zone rule in frontend/src/styles/_tokens.scss so headings and text over photos are light in light mode. Then re-check the home hero, next-event card, page headers, Mali tiles, the login side panel and the event-card media badges.
Guard /admin/staff for non-super admins, or render an error state instead of the endless skeleton.
Make the Resend branch robust: require or fallback EMAIL_FROM, and catch unexpected exceptions in try_send_email so email problems never cause 500s.
Fix the mobile navbar right-edge overflow (hamburger clipped by 2px).
Optional: add Escape and arrow keys to the lightbox; lowercase ADMIN_EMAIL consistently in seed.
critical_code_review_comments: security.py: is_approved_admin is checked per request, so revoking access works immediately for existing sessions (verified: stats returns 403 and /me returns role 'pending'). Good.
staff.py endpoints exclude ADMIN_EMAIL, so the super admin cannot revoke or delete itself (404). Good.
auth.admin_register: re-registering an unverified staff email resends the token but keeps the old password and name. Acceptable but possibly surprising.
project-form/detail: '@for track g' throws NG0955 if the same URL appears twice in the gallery. Use track $index.
Emergent email hit 'rate_limited' during testing. try_send_email handles it gracefully (email_sent false; the booking UI shows the 'non siamo riusciti a inviare' note).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_giguiya_mongo.py (test_admin_register_flow now expects 403 for a verified but unapproved staff login)

success_rate.frontend: 80% (functional flows all pass; light-theme readability over photos fails)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend/tests && python -m pytest -n 0 -v test_staff_gallery.py test_giguiya_mongo.py (33 tests). Running the suite triggers many emails and can hit the Emergent email rate limit; email_sent false is expected then. The UI staff test needs a DB-created verified TEST staff (register via API, then set email_verified true with pymongo). Gallery UI: set_input_files on [data-testid=admin-project-gallery-upload-input]. Lightbox state reads need about 500ms waits (animation and signal render). Light theme: localStorage.setItem('giguiya-theme','light') and reload. Do not touch info@giguiya.it.
rca of the issue: Light-mode dark text on photos: CSS custom properties are inherited, but 'color' is computed once on body (color: var(--text) resolves to dark there). Children of .hero and the other photo zones inherit the computed colour, not the variable, so redefining --text on .hero has no effect unless .hero also sets color: var(--text). Reproduce: localStorage giguiya-theme=light, open /, then getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.hero h1')).color returns rgb(28,25,21) while .hero --text is #f4f4f6. Mitigation: add color: var(--text) to the photo-zone selector list in _tokens.scss.
